parameters.name: CollectInterval
parameters.description:
The collection period of the metric. Valid values:

*   15
*   60

Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the metric import task.

parameters.name: SLSProcessConfig
parameters.description: The configurations of the logs that are imported from Simple Log Service.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the metric import task.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a metric import task, see [DescribeHybridMonitorTaskList](~~428624~~).

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The name of the metric import task.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a metric import task, see [DescribeHybridMonitorTaskList](~~428624~~).
